changelog:
Massgram beta 12.5.6-beta2

- Fixed Massgram premium transport so ordinary text no longer degrades into Unsupported Massgram message when local premium features are enabled
- Added Massgram-only premium custom emoji transport so rich text is visible to Massgram clients and falls back to Unsupported Massgram message on regular clients
- Opened the local premium UI gates for premium stickers and premium emoji in picker, search, preview and suggestion flows
- Preserved compatibility between AES-256 chat encryption and Massgram-only premium payloads in private chats
